description: This file implements the IpcClientControllerImpl class and related factory functions for IPC control in the Rialto project. It includes methods for managing RPC controller state, error handling, and cancellation (not implemented).

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::ipc::IControllerFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating IPC controller factories.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::ipc::ControllerFactory
classes.description: Concrete implementation of IControllerFactory that creates ClientControllerImpl instances.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::ipc::ClientControllerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of an IPC client controller managing RPC state, errors, and cancellation.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::ipc::IControllerFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new ControllerFactory instance.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::ipc::ControllerFactory::create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new ClientControllerImpl instance.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::ipc::ClientControllerImpl::Reset
methods.description: Resets the controller's failed state and reason, preparing it for a new RPC call.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::ipc::ClientControllerImpl::Failed
methods.description: Returns whether the last RPC call failed.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::ipc::ClientControllerImpl::ErrorText
methods.description: Returns a human-readable error message if the last RPC call failed.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::ipc::ClientControllerImpl::StartCancel
methods.description: Logs a warning that cancellation is not implemented.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::ipc::ClientControllerImpl::setMethodCallFailed
methods.description: Sets the controller state to failed with a given reason.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::ipc::ClientControllerImpl::setMethodCallFailed
methods.description: Sets the controller state to failed with a formatted reason string.
